title: Pet Sematary
author: Stephen King
summary: A doctor moves his young family into a Maine house beside a busy road. Behind it lies an old burial ground in the woods, and its power tempts him after tragedy strikes.
readIf: you want horror that works through grief and parental fear rather than monsters in the dark.
skipIf: you cannot read about the death of a child or a pet.

pairings.reason: A classic of quiet dread, in which the damage is mostly psychological.
Another horror novel about a ghost that follows someone from his past, with a faster pace.
Not horror, but a moving look at how a family handles a child's death.
